title: Massively parallel long-read sequencing of single cell RNA isoforms
author: Jafar S Jabbari
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.8d9hs96
materials: Sub-Sampling, Post GEM-RT Cleanup and cDNA Amplification
Optimise cDNA PCR for long-read library preparation. In a thermocycler with heated lead, incubate as follows:
Quantify 1 µl with Qubit dsDNA HS assay.

steps.title: GEM Generation and Barcoding
steps.instruction: Perform GEM Generation and Barcoding for the required number of cells following the 10x Genomics user guide for Single Cell Gene Expression (v3), Single Cell Immune Profiling (v1 Chemistry), Next Gem single cell 3’ (v3.1 Chemistry), or Single Cell Immune Profiling (v1.1 Chemistry).

steps.title: GEM-RT Incubation
steps.instruction: Perform GEM-RT Incubation according to the user guide. Optionally, extend RT time up to 2 hours to potentially increase the number of longer transcripts.

steps.title: Prepare Sub-Sampling Cleanup Mix
steps.instruction: Prepare the Sub-Sampling Cleanup Mix based on the chemistry used.

substeps.instruction: For v1 chemistry: Add 2.5 µl Additive A to 97.5 µl EB.
For v3 chemistry: Add 2 µl Reducing Agent B to 98 µl EB.

steps.title: Sub-Sample GEMs
steps.instruction: Isolate a sub-sample of GEMs from the emulsion.

substeps.instruction: Transfer 125 µl Recovery Reagent into a fresh well of an 8-strip tube.
Dispense 63 µl of Sub-Sampling Cleanup Mix into the well containing Recovery Reagent.

Transfer 10-20 µl of GEMs from the middle of the opaque emulsion layer into the Recovery Agent/Cleanup Mix. (Note: For GEM volumes > 20 μl, reduce Sub-Sampling Cleanup Mix volume by 0.7 μl for every 1 μl added and add that volume to remaining GEMs later).
Pipette-mix several times to break the emulsions.
Slowly remove 125 µl of Recovery Agent (pink) from the bottom according to the 10x user guide.

steps.title: Post GEM-RT Cleanup
steps.instruction: Perform Post GEM-RT Cleanup using Dynabeads MyOne SILANE according to the v1 or v3 user guide for both the sub-sampled fraction and the remaining GEMs (processed as per 10x user guide).

steps.title: cDNA Amplification
steps.instruction: Set up cDNA Amplification reactions for both fractions according to the user guide. (Note: Chromium Single Cell 5’ Library Construction Kit reagents can be used for extra amplification).

substeps.instruction: Adjust PCR cycle numbers for each fraction based on cell number.
Optionally increase extension time to 3 min to allow efficient extension of longer cDNA fragments.
Carry out cleanup as per the 10x user guide.

steps.title: Short-Read Library Construction and Sequencing
steps.instruction: Prepare and sequence short-read Illumina libraries for the main sample and sub-sample separately.

substeps.instruction: Carry out Gene Expression Library Construction according to the user guide (Chromium Single Cell 5’ Library Construction Kit reagents may be used for extra prep).
Perform sequencing according to 10x user guide recommendations.

steps.title: Optimize PCR Cycles for Long-Read Template
steps.instruction: Determine the optimum number of PCR cycles to yield at least 6 ng/µl cDNA without changing the peak distribution.

substeps.instruction: After 8 cycles, take 5 µl out for analysis.
Repeat from Denaturation for 2 extra cycles, take 5 µl out, and continue for another 2 cycles up to 14 cycles.
Quantify 2 µl of each sample from different cycles using Qubit dsDNA High Sensitivity assay.
Dilute each sample to 1 ng/µl and run on HSD5000 Tape to evaluate peak distribution.

steps.title: Bulk cDNA Generation for Long-Read Prep
steps.instruction: Generate a sufficient amount of cDNA using the optimized cycle number.

substeps.instruction: Set up 5 PCR reactions and cycle them to the determined optimum number.
Pool PCR reactions and add 0.6x SpriSelect beads; mix.
Incubate at room temperature for 5 min.
Place on magnet until the solution clears.
Incubate for 2 min at room temperature.
Place on magnet until the solution clears.
Remove the supernatant.
Wash the pellet by adding 200 µl freshly prepared 80% ethanol; wait 30 sec.
Remove ethanol and repeat the wash step for a total of 2 washes.
Centrifuge briefly, place on magnet, and remove any remaining ethanol.
Air dry for 2 min (avoid overdrying/cracking beads).
Remove from magnet, add 50 µl Buffer EB, and pipette mix 15x.
Transfer 49 µl of solution to a new tube without disturbing the beads.
QC amplified cDNA by running a 1 ng/µl dilution on HSD5000 Tape.

steps.title: Long-Read Sequencing
steps.instruction: Prepare and sequence the full-length cDNA library.

substeps.instruction: Prepare library for Nanopore or PacBio sequencing according to the relevant protocol.
Determine sequencing depth based on captured cell number, sample source, required resolution, and platform (using Illumina UMI counts as a guide).
